title: Dareplane proof of concept: STN LFP, ECoG and EOG during the CopyDraw task with open- and closed-loop DBS (1 Parkinson's disease patient)
description: Intracranial recordings from one Parkinson's disease patient with externalised bilateral subthalamic DBS leads and an epidural ECoG strip over left primary motor cortex, acquired on days 2-4 after implantation. The patient performed the CopyDraw task with DBS off, continuous open-loop DBS, and closed-loop adaptive DBS run on the Dareplane platform. The dataset includes STN local field potentials, ECoG, EOG, auxiliary analog channels and event markers, and serves as a proof of concept for the Dareplane open-source BCI platform.
methods_description: Recordings were made with a Neuro Omega system at 22 kHz (24 channels: 16 DBS contacts from Boston Scientific Vercise directional leads, 4 epidural ECoG contacts, 4 EOG channels) while the patient performed the CopyDraw task with stimulation off, open-loop on, or closed-loop adaptive DBS. ECoG was referenced to the left earlobe and DBS recordings to the left mastoid. Event markers came from the Neuro Omega port and stimulation marker channels.
